name: Mystery no Arukikata 2: Ningyo Densetsu Satsujin Jiken
original_name: ミステリーの歩き方2 人魚伝説殺人事件
source:
A story about a mermaid legend. Doppo investigates a murder that took place 20 years ago, only to see a new tragedy unfold.

[From [url=https://x.com/ErogeAreAlive/status/2083853589714206767]Visual Novel News[/url]]

一则围绕人鱼传说展开的故事。独步着手调查一桩发生在20年前的杀人事件，却目睹一场新的悲剧在眼前上演。

[摘自[url=https://x.com/ErogeAreAlive/status/2083853589714206767]Visual Novel News[/url]]
